description: License policy of the DragonBreath image. license_check.py fails if a linked package has a license that is not in 'allowed', or no license and no entry in 'packages'. An SPDX expression passes if each AND term has at least one allowed OR alternative.

esp_libc-sbom_picolibc.yml.source: riscv32-esp-elf/share/licenses/picolibc/COPYING.picolibc of the toolchain: the newlib default license, BSD-2-Clause and BSD-3-Clause variants and other permissive licenses. Its GPL-2.0 and AGPL-3.0 entries are for scripts/GeneratePicolibcCrossFile.sh and test/printf-tests.c only, which are not in the library. The release notices include this file.
